label: Bernardo di Bandino Baroncelli
summary: Killer of Giuliano de' Medici in the Pazzi conspiracy of 1478, hanged in Florence in December 1479; Leonardo drew his hanged body.

claims.statement: Extradited from Constantinople and hanged at the Palazzo del Bargello on 29 December 1479; one source gives 28 December.

value.text: Leonardo's drawing of him hanged, December 1479

claims.statement: A drawing by Leonardo (Musée Bonnat Helleu, Bayonne) shows the hanged man with notes on his clothing in Leonardo's mirror script, naming 'Bernardo di Bandino Baroncelli'.
